name: Hateful Days
source:
George Prinkerton gets caught in a time loop. For every person, this is something shocking and even terrifying. It would seem that a very simple young man is transferred into the cycle of events that will forever change his life, because time does not tolerate the subjunctive mood, and the hands of the clock inexorably continue their countdown to the next tragedy. 

Will you help him get out of this mess, or will you drag him into something more related to what is not given to man to understand? It all depends on you.

[Edited from [url=https://notraincorp.itch.io/hateful-days]itch.io[/url]]
